title: REQ · LifecycleStepper carries no execution-derived stage logic
summary: Remove deriveStage and EXECUTION_STAGES from LifecycleStepper
description: Context: LifecycleStepper.tsx exports EXECUTION_STAGES and deriveStage(roundStatus, executionStatus), which map execution statuses to stages. Execution no longer exists and AdminApp only passes round.status. Desired behavior: only STAGES, stageIndex and LifecycleStepper remain. Expected result: the stepper renders the same as before. Why: it removes the last frontend reference to execution state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the LifecycleStepper module, when its exports are inspected, then deriveStage is undefined and STAGES, stageIndex and LifecycleStepper are still exported
Given status CLOSED, when LifecycleStepper renders, then the CLOSED step has aria-current=step and OPEN is done
Given LifecycleStepper.tsx, when its source is read, then it contains no 'execution' text
